gates.correctness: All trials pass existing reference/error contracts; max relative error <= 1e-4 where applicable.
gates.same_protocol: Compare incumbent, candidate and matched NPU baseline under each source operator's timing/statistic/warmup/repetition contract; keep raw trials and provenance.
gates.candidate_closure: Include the current deployed incumbent in every shape's candidate set; validate the selected winner on independent trials.
gates.full_matrix_non_regression: After targeted wins, rerun the complete declared C2C/R2C/C2R grids and E2E/application guards; no correctness or supported-shape regression, and retain incumbent wherever a winner regresses.
gates.uncertainty: Report trial distribution and unstable outcomes explicitly; a parity-band label does not close a speedup < 1 target.

phases.purpose: Close the only C2C device-only sub-unity point.
Close all strict sub-unity real-forward points, including near-unity points.
Close the remaining real-inverse sub-unity point.

hardware_mapping_search_axes: stage partition and local tile size
local radix or arithmetic-core selection (orthogonal to flow mapping)
transfer packing and real/complex pre/post-processing fusion
UB layout, capacity and live-state accounting
buffer count and producer/consumer overlap where legal and measured
